jp.kyasu.util

クラス CompareAdapter

  • java.lang.Object
    • jp.kyasu.util.CompareAdapter
  • すべての実装されたインタフェース:
    Comparer

    public abstract class CompareAdapter
extends java.lang.Object
implements Comparer
    The adapter for the comparison operations. The methods in this class are empty; this class is provided as a convenience for easily creating comparers by extending this class and overriding only the methods of interest.
    関連項目:
    Comparer, Sorter
